## ComponentDefinition (core.oam.dev/v1beta1, namespaced-scoped)

### spec

- `spec.childResourceKinds` []object: ChildResourceKinds are the list of GVK of the child resources this workload generates
  - `spec.childResourceKinds[].apiVersion` string required: APIVersion of the child resource
  - `spec.childResourceKinds[].kind` string required: Kind of the child resource
  - `spec.childResourceKinds[].selector` map[string]string: Selector to select the child resources that the workload wants to expose to traits
- `spec.extension` object (free-form): Extension is used for extension needs by OAM platform builders
- `spec.podSpecPath` string: PodSpecPath indicates where/if this workload has K8s podSpec field if one workload has podSpec, trait can do lot's of assumption such as port, env, volume fi...
- `spec.revisionLabel` string: RevisionLabel indicates which label for underlying resources(e.g.
- `spec.schematic` object: Schematic defines the data format and template of the encapsulation of the workload
  - `spec.schematic.cue` object: CUE defines the encapsulation in CUE format
    - `spec.schematic.cue.template` string required: Template defines the abstraction template data of the capability, it will replace the old CUE template in extension field.
  - `spec.schematic.terraform` object: Terraform is the struct to describe cloud resources managed by Hashicorp Terraform
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.configuration` string required: Configuration is Terraform Configuration
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.customRegion` string: Region is cloud provider's region.
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.deleteResource` boolean: DeleteResource will determine whether provisioned cloud resources will be deleted when CR is deleted
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.gitCredentialsSecretReference` object: GitCredentialsSecretReference specifies the reference to the secret containing the git credentials
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.gitCredentialsSecretReference.name` string: name is unique within a namespace to reference a secret resource.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.gitCredentialsSecretReference.namespace` string: namespace defines the space within which the secret name must be unique.
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.path` string: Path is the sub-directory of remote git repository.
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.providerRef` object: ProviderReference specifies the reference to Provider
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.providerRef.name` string required: Name of the referenced object.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.providerRef.namespace` string: Namespace of the referenced object.
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.type` string: Type specifies which Terraform configuration it is, HCL or JSON syntax
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.writeConnectionSecretToRef` object: WriteConnectionSecretToReference specifies the namespace and name of a Secret to which any connection details for this managed resource should be written.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name` string required: Name of the secret.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.writeConnectionSecretToRef.namespace` string: Namespace of the secret.
- `spec.status` object: Status defines the custom health policy and status message for workload
  - `spec.status.customStatus` string: CustomStatus defines the custom status message that could display to user
  - `spec.status.details` string: Details stores a string representation of a CUE status map to be evaluated at runtime for display
  - `spec.status.healthPolicy` string: HealthPolicy defines the health check policy for the abstraction
- `spec.version` string
- `spec.workload` object required: Workload is a workload type descriptor
  - `spec.workload.definition` object: Definition mutually exclusive to workload.type, a embedded WorkloadDefinition
    - `spec.workload.definition.apiVersion` string required
    - `spec.workload.definition.kind` string required
  - `spec.workload.type` string: Type ref to a WorkloadDefinition via name

### status

- `status.conditions` []object: Conditions of the resource.
  - `status.conditions[].lastTransitionTime` string required: LastTransitionTime is the last time this condition transitioned from one status to another.
  - `status.conditions[].message` string: A Message containing details about this condition's last transition from one status to another, if any.
  - `status.conditions[].reason` string required: A Reason for this condition's last transition from one status to another.
  - `status.conditions[].status` string required: Status of this condition; is it currently True, False, or Unknown?
  - `status.conditions[].type` string required: Type of this condition.
- `status.configMapRef` string: ConfigMapRef refer to a ConfigMap which contains OpenAPI V3 JSON schema of Component parameters.
- `status.latestRevision` object: LatestRevision of the component definition
  - `status.latestRevision.name` string required
  - `status.latestRevision.revision` integer required
  - `status.latestRevision.revisionHash` string: RevisionHash record the hash value of the spec of ApplicationRevision object.

## TraitDefinition (core.oam.dev/v1beta1, namespaced-scoped)

### spec

- `spec.appliesToWorkloads` []string: AppliesToWorkloads specifies the list of workload kinds this trait applies to.
- `spec.conflictsWith` []string: ConflictsWith specifies the list of traits(CRD name, Definition name, CRD group) which could not apply to the same workloads with this trait.
- `spec.controlPlaneOnly` boolean: ControlPlaneOnly defines which cluster is dispatched to
- `spec.definitionRef` object: Reference to the CustomResourceDefinition that defines this trait kind.
  - `spec.definitionRef.name` string required: Name of the referenced CustomResourceDefinition.
  - `spec.definitionRef.version` string: Version indicate which version should be used if CRD has multiple versions by default it will use the first one if not specified
- `spec.extension` object (free-form): Extension is used for extension needs by OAM platform builders
- `spec.manageWorkload` boolean: ManageWorkload defines the trait would be responsible for creating the workload
- `spec.podDisruptive` boolean: PodDisruptive indicates that this trait is disruptive to the pod: applying or updating it should cause the workload's pods to restart.
- `spec.revisionEnabled` boolean: Revision indicates whether a trait is aware of component revision

    - `spec.schematic.terraform.configuration` string required: Configuration is Terraform Configuration

    - `spec.schematic.terraform.gitCredentialsSecretReference` object: GitCredentialsSecretReference specifies the reference to the secret containing the git credentials
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.gitCredentialsSecretReference.name` string: name is unique within a namespace to reference a secret resource.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.gitCredentialsSecretReference.namespace` string: namespace defines the space within which the secret name must be unique.
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.path` string: Path is the sub-directory of remote git repository.
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.providerRef` object: ProviderReference specifies the reference to Provider
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.providerRef.name` string required: Name of the referenced object.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.providerRef.namespace` string: Namespace of the referenced object.
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.type` string: Type specifies which Terraform configuration it is, HCL or JSON syntax
    - `spec.schematic.terraform.writeConnectionSecretToRef` object: WriteConnectionSecretToReference specifies the namespace and name of a Secret to which any connection details for this managed resource should be written.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name` string required: Name of the secret.
      - `spec.schematic.terraform.writeConnectionSecretToRef.namespace` string: Namespace of the secret.
- `spec.stage` string: Stage defines the stage information to which this trait resource processing belongs.
- `spec.status` object: Status defines the custom health policy and status message for trait
  - `spec.status.customStatus` string: CustomStatus defines the custom status message that could display to user
